posts.description: We have released version 1.0.0 of the iClaustron API. The github tree is at https://github.com/logicalclocks/iclaustron Training material for Rust is available here Training material for C is available here Extensive training material on RonDB is available here Some takeaways: 1. MIT licensed 2. Receiver thread only routing messages => Scales to 3x more CPUs 3. Capable of doing 9M key lookups per

posts.title: PeakAIO contributes support of 8k API nodes to RonDB 26.02.11
posts.description: PeakAIO develops pNFS Lattice, a new parallel file system using RonDB as a metadata server. To support larger clusters they needed more API nodes. RonDB 25.10 added support for 2039 API nodes, now 26.02.11 when released will support 8191 API nodes.
